 tripurastarnews30 
 November 15, 2026 
 Spread the love 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra, 15th of November, 2026 : When Dhanush’s full-on mass avatar, Mammootty’s commanding screen presence and Sai Pallavi’s fearless attitude come together, the excitement automatically reaches another level. The trailer of ‘O.M.: Chapter 1 – Udhiram: The Blood Wood’ has been unveiled, instantly sparking curiosity among audiences. Directed by Rajkumar Periasamy, the trailer sets the stage for an intriguing blend of action, mystery and intense confrontations, promising something extraordinary on the big screen.
 Dhanush impresses with his aggressive and powerful action-packed avatar, while Mammootty leaves a strong impact with his commanding yet understated presence. Sai Pallavi, portraying IPS officer Nithya Reddy, emerges as a major highlight with her intense, fearless and determined personality. Sreeleela, too, adds freshness and charm to the narrative, making the trailer even more captivating.
